Tekion CHN._comment: Chennai site. "Its rules are the same as Tekion BLR" — so this is Tekion's block re-keyed to this site, with the names prefixed so the two counters' diagnostics stay distinguishable. TWO CLIENT DECISIONS shape what is here. (1) The theme map stays Chennai's OWN (Mon/Tue mix, Wed south, Thu biryani, Fri north) rather than copying BLR's — so the weekday rules below land on different themes than they do in Bangalore, and each was checked against what Chennai can actually serve on that day: Friday is north and Chennai has 6 north non-veg biryanis, Wednesday is south and has 10 south chicken gravies, and the Thursday khichdi is unaffected because Chennai's ruleset exempts `rice` from theme filtering altogether. (2) NO CHINESE at this site, so BLR's two Chinese-Tuesday rules are deliberately absent — Tuesday is a `mix` day here and takes whatever the other rules allow. BLR's `indian_veg_dry_on_chinese_day` is absent for the same reason, and would have been anyway: Chennai's ruleset exempts `veg_dry` from theme filtering, so there is nothing for it to narrow. ONE THIN POOL to know about: Chennai has only ONE south paneer gravy (`paneer_kurma`), and Wednesday is a south day, so `tekion_chn_paneer_gravy_wednesday` can be met on one Wednesday per 20-day cooldown window and relaxes on the others. `diagnose()` reports it; the fix is more south paneer gravies in the Chennai list, not a config change.

rules._comment: 'No Chinese in Chennai Tekion.' Dropping BLR's two Chinese-Tuesday MANDATES was not enough and the solve proved it: Tuesday is a `mix` day here, the theme filter does not narrow a mix day at all, and Chennai's ruleset additionally exempts `salad`, `veg_dry` and most other slots from cuisine filtering — so a Chinese dish was simply eligible everywhere and Friday's salad came back `american_coleslaw`, a row the Chennai import had mislabelled `chinese` (since corrected to continental). Not scoped to a slot, because the client's sentence is not: no Chinese anywhere on the counter. Safe as a hard `max: 0` because no day at this site is themed chinese, so the theme filter can never force one (CLAUDE.md note 9e).
rules.name: tekion_chn_no_chinese

rules._comment: Chennai carries 13 liquid rices, so this cap and the Thursday khichdi below both have something to act on.
rules.name: tekion_chn_liquid_rice_once

rules._comment: Non-veg gravy Monday and Wednesday, chicken biryani Friday, mirroring Tekion BLR. Tuesday and Thursday are blank via tekion_chn_nonveg_mwf. Under this site's own theme map Monday is `mix` (not narrowed at all) and Wednesday is `south` (10 south chicken gravies), while Friday is `north` and Chennai carries 6 north non-veg biryanis — so every component has something to place. Mon/Wed exclude is_egg_dish because a few egg dishes are mis-flagged is_south_chicken_gravy in the ontology.
rules.name: tekion_chn_nonveg_by_weekday

rules._comment: Paneer gravy every Wednesday. Wednesday is a SOUTH day at this site and Chennai has exactly one south paneer gravy, so this is met once per cooldown window and relaxes otherwise — see the note in the client header. Kept rather than dropped because the requirement is real and the shortfall is a data gap the diagnostics report.
rules.name: tekion_chn_paneer_gravy_wednesday

rules._comment: Khichdi every Thursday. There is no is_khichdi flag; every khichdi carries is_liquid_rice, and tekion_chn_liquid_rice_once caps liquid rice at one a week, so pinning Thursday lands that one there. Thursday is this site's biryani day, which would normally narrow the rice pool to biryanis — but Chennai's ruleset exempts `rice` from the theme filter, so the 13 liquid rices stay eligible.
rules.name: tekion_chn_khichdi_thursday
